title: Changing the pump resets superbolus
symptom: When a superbolus is active and the user changes the pump, AAPS sets default basal rate and deactivates superbolus mode, even though superbolus is active and basal rate should be zero for the next 2 hours.
cause: The maintainer states that changing the pump resets the running TBR, which is pump-specific and will not be handled by AAPS. However, a user argues that the issue is about superbolus and that AAPS could store superbolus state and restore zero TBR after pump change.
fix: No fix was implemented. The maintainer said it will not be handled by AAPS. A user suggested storing superbolus flag and start time, then applying zero TBR after pump change if superbolus was active and time not completed.
evidence_quote: yes, changing pump resets running TBR. That's pump specific and will not be handled by AAPS
